description: This file defines a Spring REST controller named 'TaxController' for handling tax calculation endpoints within a Java-based web service. It provides an API for calculating tax on a cart or order, including annotation-driven documentation via Swagger/OpenAPI, request validation, and dependency injection of a service layer.

classes.name: TaxController
classes.description: A REST controller providing tax calculation endpoints, with request mappings and Swagger annotations for API documentation.

methods.name: calculate
methods.description: Handles POST requests to compute tax based on provided cart or order details. Uses validation and delegates to the TaxCalculationService.
